description.zh:
业务类型，取值：

- **dcdn_log_access_l1**（默认值）：用户访问日志。
- **dcdn_log_er**：边缘程序日志。
- **dcdn_log_waf**：WAF拦截日志。
description.en:
The type of the collected logs. Default value: cdn\_log\_access\_l1. Valid values:

- **cdn\_log\_access\_l1**: access logs of Dynamic Content Delivery Network (DCDN) points of presence (POPs)

- **cdn\_log\_origin**: back-to-origin logs

- **cdn\_log\_er**: EdgeRoutine logs

- By default, this parameter is left empty, and all logs are returned.

description.zh: 域名，仅支持单个域名查询。不填为空则表示查询所有域名。
description.en: The domain name. You can specify only one domain name in each request. If this parameter is not specified, all domain names are queried.
The number of the page to return. Valid values: **1** to **100000**. Default value: 1.
The number of entries to return on each page. The default value is 20.

title.zh: 查询用户开通的项目信息

descriptions.en: > Each account can call this operation up to 100 times per second.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn list-dcdn-real-time-delivery-project --business-type cdn_log_access_l1 --domain-name example.com --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --region cn-hangzhou
